output.reason: A 70-year-old with severe cramping abdominal pain since last night, visible distension, three episodes of vomiting and no bowel movement for three days has a presentation consistent with bowel obstruction, which needs immediate emergency imaging, decompression and surgical assessment.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Severe cramping pain with a bloated belly, repeated vomiting and no bowel movement for three days can mean a blocked bowel, which needs urgent imaging and hospital treatment. Do not eat or drink on the way. Have someone drive you, or call 911 if pain becomes constant and severe, you faint, or you vomit blood.
